name: Phone push
description: Sends cockpit's notifications to your phone through ntfy or Pushover: a session waiting, checks failing, a task done, autopilot giving up. Sessions left waiting get a second, high-priority push.
author: cockpit

settings.label: ntfy topic
settings.help: Pick something hard to guess; anyone who knows a topic on ntfy.sh can read it

settings.label: Only the urgent ones
settings.help: Just the second nudge for sessions left waiting, and autopilot giving up

settings.label: Cockpit's address on your phone
settings.help: e.g. https://your-box.your-tailnet.ts.net:8444, so tapping a push opens the right page
